title: Magnetic Field Magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (1) must be B = 2 T.

title: Heat Generated
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer for part (2) must be Q = 0.075 J.

title: Velocity from Graph
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify the terminal velocity (v = 1.0 m/s) from the provided v-t graph.

title: Force Balance Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law at terminal velocity, setting the gravitational force equal to the magnetic (Ampere) force.

title: Circuit Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly combine motional EMF, Ohm's law, and the total circuit resistance (R + r) to find the induced current.

title: Joule Heating Formula
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for Joule heating (Q = I²Rt) for the specific resistor R over the given time.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student's solution should demonstrate consistent use of SI units (m, kg, s, A, T, J) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign Error in Force Direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the magnetic force is given the wrong sign/direction, opposing the motion instead of opposing gravity.

title: Resistance Misidentification
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses only R or only r in the Ohm's law or Joule heating calculations, instead of the correct series combination.
